historical_sample_status: All dates through 2026-10-08 have been opened in prior research. These are exploratory comparisons only.

common.new_independent_evidence: future signals only after protocol and data snapshot freeze
common.monthly_ic: per-date Spearman, equal-weight months; no annualization
common.execution: original V1.6 Buffer30/60 and cost configuration for eligible A/B models

A.A0: unchanged Equal8 score as a reference
A.A1: industry-relative labels: requires dated historical industry classifications
A.A2: Ridge(alpha=100) on the original eight features and point-in-time CH-4 residual labels
A.risk_exposure: 252 prior close-to-close returns; 126 paired minimum; 4-factor OLS with intercept
A.residual_label: sum of daily adjusted stock arithmetic returns minus sum of daily risk-free and ex-ante beta times CH-4 factor returns, from after signal close to next signal close
A.factor_period: 2017-2025 complete dates only; no missing-factor interpolation
A.residual_test: monthly rank IC, positive fraction, yearly direction, and same-cost account; no route selection on 2025

B.state: signal-known CSI300 trailing 60-day return and trailing 20-day realized volatility
B.B1: Equal8 plus Ridge(alpha=100) fitted on two predefined interactions: mom_60 * trailing trend, and -vol_60 * trailing volatility
B.B2: LightGBM with original eight features, two market states and the same two interactions; fixed V1.6 tree parameters
B.training_label: same saved next open-to-open stock return cross-sectional rank as V1.6
B.test: monthly rank IC by year, same-cost account and concentration; no year-specific state labels

C.required_data: instrument,period_end,announcement_date,available_at,source_id, EP/BP/ROE/earnings-growth with source and valid units
C.status_without_data: DATA_NOT_AVAILABLE; schema and synthetic time-travel tests only

D.D1: benchmark weights plus bounded active weights
D.D2: benchmark weights plus covariance and transaction-cost optimization
D.required_data: point-in-time CSI300 constituent weights, dated industry, aligned prices
D.status_without_data: DATA_NOT_AVAILABLE; mathematical synthetic optimization tests only

decision: No candidate is an independently verified improvement until newly formed future observations pass a separately frozen evaluation; all negative and missing-data results remain visible in local research records.
